verdict.rationale: Moosend's pricing page documents its own reporting feature, tailored dashboards for tracking key performance indicators, plus 'advanced data insights'. That is a first-party analytics capability, but its depth for this story is unproven. The evidence never names opens, clicks, unsubscribes or conversions, nor breakdowns per campaign, per automation step or over time. missing for 10: explicit per-campaign open/click/unsubscribe/conversion reports, per-automation-step metrics, time-series trend views, in-depth reporting docs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time

citations.quote: Create tailored dashboards for tracking key performance indicators.
Leverage advanced data insights to better understand and target your audience.
